name: Steak Diane with Mashed Potatoes

components.name: Steak Diane

ingredients.name: Lean steak (rump, scotch or sirloin), diced

steps: Toss steak cubes with paprika, garlic and onion powders, pepper and salt.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Sear steak cubes quickly in separate batches; transfer to a dish.
Melt butter in same pan, add minced garlic and tomato paste and cook briefly.
Whisk gravy granules into hot water separately, then pour into pan and simmer until glossy. Add Worcestershire and cream.
Turn off heat, fold steak through the sauce, and divide with mash into five containers.

components.name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Start potatoes in cold salted water. Boil until easily pierced, approximately 15 minutes.
Drain thoroughly, add butter and warm milk, and mash just until smooth; avoid overmixing.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Optional garnish: chopped parsley and cracked black pepper.
Freezer: Publisher approves freezing. Reheat gently; cream sauce and steak texture may degrade with overheating.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
